name: Lien BondMaker exception-count bond exchange mint
summary: BondMakerCollateralizedEth.exchangeEquivalentBonds checked only the total count of exception matches, so groups listing a bond twice let the attacker except every input bond and mint unbacked bonds. Lien's OTC exchanges priced these permissionlessly registered bonds from payoff metadata alone and paid for them from an LP's USDC allowance.
notes: The OTC exchanges are listed with the BondMakers as a conjunctive failure (the post-mortem's second gap: pricing unbacked, attacker-registered bonds); all five are immutable, and the latest deployment sets the age.

A copycat minted unbacked LBT/SBT through the same exception bug and burned them back for collateral ETH from BondMaker 0x843225cf; later exchanges by other accounts minted bonds but extracted nothing.
